discoveryPolicy.variant: exact ordered activities, explicit concurrency groups and branch sequence; loops are preserved
discoveryPolicy.precedence: predecessor last occurrence strictly before successor first occurrence
discoveryPolicy.mandatory: trace support rate greater than or equal to the configured threshold
discoveryPolicy.optional: observed activity below the configured mandatory threshold
discoveryPolicy.parallel: explicit concurrency evidence only; timestamps never establish parallelism
discoveryPolicy.recovery: recovery_started retains preceding trigger, following resume activity and suffix sequence
discoveryPolicy.failure: failed outcomes or explicit failure events form separate failure variants
discoveryPolicy.contradiction: observed reverse ordering or explicit parent ordering against a parallel candidate
discoveryPolicy.workflowPatternAuthority: evidence-only; no Skill binding, Artifact candidate, schema, completion contract or online routing authority

qualityMetrics.support: selected cohort support; 1 for a pattern built from the complete selected cohort
qualityMetrics.successRate: succeeded trace count divided by cohort trace count
qualityMetrics.traceCoverage: selected trace coverage; 1 after exact cohort validation
qualityMetrics.fitness: mean fraction of mandatory activities present per trace
qualityMetrics.precisionProxy: constraints with strictly more support than contradictions divided by retained constraints
qualityMetrics.environmentCoverage: distinct environment/device classes divided by trace count, capped at 1
qualityMetrics.contradictionRate: distinct contradiction trace count divided by trace count
qualityMetrics.generalization: log2(trace count + 1)/4 capped at 1, multiplied by one minus contradiction rate
